# PDF fixture licenses

Each fixture under `tests/fixtures/pdfs/` is recorded here with its provenance
and license. Fixtures land in phase 2 (`digital-clean/*.pdf`), phase 3
(`digital-broken/*.pdf`), phase 4 (`image-scan/*.pdf`), and phase 9 (full
benchmark corpus including `mixed/` and `edge/`).

| Fixture | Phase added | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| _none yet_ | — | — | — |

The license-audit harness is permissive about fixture content (it reads only
`models.toml` and the live distribution set) — fixture licensing is enforced
manually at PR-review time, not in CI.
